description: GET /api/dataset and GET /data/dataset.json return the whole dataset (meta, periods, people, events, relationships, locations, books, journeys) in one response
--export-dataset <path> writes the dataset JSON and exits without starting the server
verification: File is written and parses as JSON

description: Older query endpoints (timeline, people, events, search, lineage, map) remain and are tested
Lineage endpoint returns siblings who share a parent or are linked by a 'sibling' row in person_relationships
verification: GET /api/lineage/37 lists the four brothers of Jesus as siblings with null father_id/mother_id
GET /api/lineage/144 lists Jesus as a sibling

description: Seed holds 375 people, 241 events, 95 locations, 536 scripture references, 18 periods, 66 books, 5 journeys with explicit stable ids
verification: SeedData.sql loads in one transaction on an empty database

description: people.role and events.category use the controlled vocabularies listed in Schema.sql and AGENTS.md
One Ussher-based chronology with no year 0; anchors: Creation 4004 BC, Flood 2349 BC, Abraham 1996 BC, Exodus 1491 BC, kingdom divides 975 BC, fall of Jerusalem 588 BC
No death before birth, no event ending before it starts, parents born at least 12 years before children (three documented exceptions), contiguous time periods, unique names
father_id chain from Jesus reaches Adam with no cycle; brothers of Jesus have no parents and are sibling rows
Every scripture reference's chapter and verses exist in the local KJV text
Integration tests always run against the current seed: the stale test database is deleted before each run
verification: Create tests/BibleTimeline.Tests/bin/Debug/net9.0/faith-through-time.db with old data, run dotnet test; the file is replaced

description: Layer rules, fetch only in api.js, no console.log or debugger, no hard-coded /api URLs outside api.js, no HTML string injection, index.html assets exist, authored JSON parses

Hash router and view registry: #/ home, #/timeline, #/story/<tour>/<step>, #/meet/<a>/<b>, #/family/<slug>, #/map/<journey>, #/read/<book>/<chapter>, #/about; #/person and #/event open a detail sheet over the current view
verification: Open each route in the browser; the matching view shows and the URL stays the source of truth
Browser Back closes the detail sheet

description: One dataset request feeds an in-memory Store with id and slug indexes, family, overlap, contemporaries and search; Time handles years without year 0
verification: Network tab shows one data/dataset.json request on load
Store.ancestors / Store.overlap return results from the console

description: Home: hero over a band of history, discovery of the day, ways in, eras as chapters; all numbers computed from Store
verification: Counts on the page match the dataset meta
